newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Shangling to set up 1,000 sales offices.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Shangling to set up 1,000 sales offices.

text.p: Shanghai Shangling Electric Appliance plans to set up 1,000 sales offices in two years mainly in mid- and small-sized cities and rural areas, the Shanghai-based Business Newspaper said on Thursday.
The newspaper said that Shangling, one of China's biggest refrigerator producers, was shifting the emphasis from major cities where sales appeared to be reaching saturation point.

"About 90 percent of homes in the coastal cities such as Shanghai now have refrigerators, but the level is only 66 percent in small and medium cities and five percent in rural areas," the newspaper said.
It said competition in the refrigerator market was growing with sales across China falling by 1.5 percent in the first half of this year.
Of 33 refrigerator makers in China, 13 lost money in the first half of the year, the newspaper said.
